cau_hoi.cau: =ROUND(1234.5678,2) tra ve bao nhieu?
cau_hoi.chu_de: ROUND de 1: lam tron 2 chu so thap phan
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: num_digits=2 giu 2 so le: 1234.57. B tron den hang tram (1200), C luon tron len, D chi doi hien thi text.

cau_hoi.cau: Gia sale o C2 = 199.6 Poke Dollar, muon tron thanh so nguyen de hien gia ban. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.chu_de: ROUND TB 1: gia sale tron so nguyen
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: num_digits=0 tron so nguyen: 200. B giu 2 le thua, D tron den tram sai, C cung ra 199 nhung ep xuong chu khong tron thuong.

cau_hoi.C: =ROUND chi doi hien thi, gia tri goc giu nguyen
cau_hoi.D: Ca hai deu doi gia tri that
cau_hoi.cau: Khac biet cot loi giua ROUND va Number Format (Format Cells)?
cau_hoi.chu_de: ROUND TB 2: ROUND vs Number Format
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ROUND doi gia tri that trong o (tinh toan tiep dung so da tron); Number Format chi doi hien thi. A mo ta Format, C noi nguoc, D sai.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon tron 1,536 thanh 1,500 (tron tram) va 1,451 thanh 1,500 theo quy tac tron thuong. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: num_digits=-2 tron hang tram: 1536->1500 (3<5 giu), 1451->1500? 1451 tron tram = 1500? 1451 -> 1500 dung (451>=... thuc te 1451->1500). B tron le sai, C ep xuong het, D tron chuc.

cau_hoi.A: So thap phan ngau nhien tu 0 den duoi 1
cau_hoi.B: So nguyen ngau nhien tu 1 den 10
cau_hoi.C: So nguyen ngau nhien tu 0 den 100
cau_hoi.cau: =RAND() tra ve loai gia tri nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: RAND() khong tham so tra thap phan [0,1). Muon gioi han phai nhan N, muon nguyen phai boc INT.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon so nguyen ngau nhien 0-9 de boc tham Pokemon. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.chu_de: RAND TB 1: INT boc so nguyen
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: INT cat phan le sau khi nhan 10 => nguyen 0-9. A van thap phan, C ROUND van co the ra 1 nhung kem chuan, D sai cu phap (RAND khong nhan tham so).

cau_hoi.cau: Mo phong xuc xac 1-6. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: INT(RAND()*6) ra 0-5, +1 thanh 1-6. B thap phan, C INT(RAND()+1) luon =1 => *6=6 hang so, D thieu tham so (dung la RANDBETWEEN(1,6)).

cau_hoi.A: Doi Calculation sang Manual vinh vien
cau_hoi.D: Copy > Paste Values ngay sau khi u
cau_hoi.cau: Bang boc tham cu doi so moi lan nhan Enter (F9 tinh lai). Cach giu ket qua co dinh de cong bo?
cau_hoi.chu_de: RAND kho: tinh lai va co dinh
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: RAND volatile: moi tinh lai doi so. Copy > Paste Values dong bang ket qua. Protect/$ khong chan tinh lai; Manual chi hoan viec doi so.

cau_hoi.A: Do lech chuan cua TOAN BO tong the
cau_hoi.cau: =STDEV.P(E2:E755) do dai Total stats toan bo 754 Pokemon tinh dai luong gi?
cau_hoi.chu_de: STDEV.P de 1: dinh nghia tong the
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: STDEV.P = population: co toan bo tong the (E2:E755). Mau dung STDEV.S; phuong sai dung VAR; trung binh dung AVERAGE.

cau_hoi.cau: Da co day du Total stats cua tat ca Pokemon (toan bo tong the). Ham do lech chuan dung?
cau_hoi.chu_de: STDEV.P TB 1: chon P khi co tong the
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Co toan bo => STDEV.P. STDEV.S danh cho mau; AVERAGE ra trung binh; STDEVA tinh ca text/logic khac bai.

cau_hoi.C: Bo qua, chi tinh o so
cau_hoi.cau: Vung E2:E755 lan mot o chu (nhap nham). STDEV.P xu ly o chu the nao?
cau_hoi.chu_de: STDEV.P TB 2: o text bi bo qua
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: STDEV.P/S bo qua o chu/logic, chi tinh o so (khac STDEVA/STDEVPA). Nen ket qua lech nhe ma khong bao loi.

cau_hoi.A: 113.45 vi mau nho nen uoc luong cao hon
cau_hoi.B: Hai ham giong nhau nen bang nhau
cau_hoi.D: STDEV.P chia cho N con STDEV.S chia cho N-1 (mau N=754 hieu chinh Bessel)
cau_hoi.cau: Cung vung E2:E755: STDEV.P -> 113.4497844. Neu dung STDEV.S cho cung vung se hoi khac. Vi sao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: P chia N (tong the), S chia N-1 (hieu chinh Bessel cho mau) nen S hoi lon hon tren cung vung. B/C sai; A dien dat sai huong.

cau_hoi.B: Do lech chuan cua TOAN BO tong the
cau_hoi.cau: =STDEV.S(E2:E21) tren 20 Pokemon mau (khong phai toan bo) tinh dai luong gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: STDEV.S = sample: chi co 1 mau 20 dong. Co toan bo moi dung STDEV.P.

cau_hoi.cau: Chi khao sat 20 Pokemon mau de uoc luong do phan tan. Ham dung?
cau_hoi.chu_de: STDEV.S TB 1: chon S khi chi co mau
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Mau => STDEV.S. P danh cho tong the; VAR.P ra phuong sai; MEDIAN ra trung vi.

cau_hoi.cau: Can do lech chuan (khong phai phuong sai, khong phai do lech tuyet doi trung binh) cua mau E2:E21. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: VAR.S ra phuong sai (binh phuong), AVEDEV ra do lech tuyet doi trung binh. Dung STDEV.S moi ra do lech chuan mau.

cau_hoi.A: Khong tinh duoc vi thieu du lieu tong the
cau_hoi.B: Dung STDEV.P vi mau lon hon 30
cau_hoi.C: Ca hai nhu nhau, chon ham nao cung duoc
cau_hoi.D: Dung STDEV.S vi chi la mau; P danh cho tong the
cau_hoi.cau: Giai thich nao dung nhat khi chon STDEV.S thay vi STDEV.P cho mau 20 Pokemon?
cau_hoi.chu_de: STDEV.S kho: ly giai chon S
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguyen tac W3S: co toan bo => P; chi co mau => S (uoc luong, chia N-1). Nguong 30 khong doi quy tac ham; C/D sai.

cau_hoi.A: Ban sao sap xep tran, du lieu goc giu nguyen
cau_hoi.B: Sap xep truc tiep vung goc
cau_hoi.C: Loc ra cac dong thoa dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: =SORT(A2:E21,5,-1) (sap theo cot Total giam dan) khac lenh Sort thu cong o diem nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: SORT la dynamic array: tra ban sao tran (spill), goc khong doi. Sort thu cong doi truc tiep. C la FILTER, D la Remove Duplicates/UNIQUE.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon bang Pokemon sap theo cot 5 (Total) giam dan. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: sort_index=5 (cot thu 5 tu trai vung), sort_order=-1 giam dan. 1 la tang dan; -5 sai vi tri; 0 khong hop le.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon loc he Normal roi sap theo Total giam dan. Cong thuc long nhau dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: FILTER truoc lay he Normal, SORT sau sap cot 5 giam dan. A FILTER vung da sap bang DK lech dong; C truyen DK sai vi tri; D thieu DK loc.

cau_hoi.cau: =SORT(B2:B21) bao loi duoi day. Nguyen nhan kha di nhat? O D5 dang co chu "Ghi chu", cong thuc dat tai D1 tran xuong D5.
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Mang tran can vung trong; D5 co du lieu chan => #SPILL!. #N/A la tra cuu, #REF! la vung sai, #CALC! la FILTER rong.

cau_hoi.A: Danh sach gia tri duy nhat tran theo thu tu xuat hien
cau_hoi.B: Xoa han cac dong trung trong vung goc
cau_hoi.C: Dem so lan xuat hien moi gia tri
cau_hoi.D: Sap xep tang dan va xoa trung
cau_hoi.cau: =UNIQUE(C2:C21) tren cot Type tra ve gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: UNIQUE tra danh sach duy nhat tran (Grass, Fire, Water, Bug, Normal) theo thu tu xuat hien, goc giu nguyen. B la Remove Duplicates; C la COUNTIF; D la SORT+UNIQUE.

cau_hoi.cau: Dem co bao nhieu he (Type) khac nhau. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: UNIQUE lay 5 he duy nhat, COUNTA dem => 5. COUNT chi dem so; SUM cong text loi; COUNTIF thieu criteria.

cau_hoi.cau: Cot Type co o trong, UNIQUE hien so 0 thua. Cach khac phuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: O trong hien 0: loc <>"" truoc bang FILTER. B doi sang so sanh theo cot sai; C van giu 0; D chi xoa space thua.

cau_hoi.cau: Can danh sach he duy nhat sap A-Z NHUNG phai giu nguyen du lieu goc cho bao cao khac. Chon phuong an dung?
cau_hoi.chu_de: UNIQUE kho: UNIQUE vs Remove Duplicates
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: SORT+UNIQUE tra ban sao tran sap xep, goc nguyen. B xoa han du lieu goc (nguy hiem cho bao cao khac). C sai tham so, D chi loc 1 he.
